fallback.line_text: If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

GB.notes: Welsh-language line 0808 164 0123. No text service listed by Samaritans.

IN.notes: Government of India line (telemanas.mohfw.gov.in); official site failed TLS check from here, verified via findahelpline. Alt toll-free 1-800-891-4416 not verified — omitted.

FR.notes: National suicide prevention line run under the Ministry of Health. English version: 'Call 3114 (free, 24/7)'.

NG.notes: No government national line. SURPIN is a LifeLine International member; also listed on findahelpline.com/countries/ng. Hausa line +234 814 224 1007. surpin.org did not resolve; official site listed as surpinng.com.

GH.notes: National Mental Health and Suicide Prevention Helpline; confirmed in Ghana News Agency/Graphic reports (Sep 2026). Hours NOT confirmed — do not claim 24/7. findahelpline lists 193 (ambulance) as emergency.

KE.notes: Not 24/7 — weekdays only. Kenya Red Cross 1199 is commonly cited as 24/7 but was not verified on an official page; consider adding after a human check.

JM.notes: Ministry of Health & Wellness Mental Health and Suicide Prevention Helpline (moh.gov.jm). Youth text line: SUPPORT to 876-838-4897 (U-Matter, ages 16–24).

TT.notes: Also 866-5433 (toll-free) or 220-3636. Lifeline TT site: lifelinett.com. findcarett is the Ministry of Health's FindCareTT directory.
